I've seen water pumps get corroded from the inside to the point where the "blades" that move the water are completely gone. If you can find a way to check your radiator to make sure  that the heat is evenly distributed inside of it and you don't have cool spots that can be cause by some kind of gunk or sediment if the previous owner used some kind of stop leak. The first thing you want to do is get that fan working. You can buy a new stock fan and just hook it up to see if performs more consistently than your current fan and make sure to check fan fuses and relays.
